Description: Grid-size sensitivity with the b-value neighbourhood scaled to the grid: 0.3 deg cells, 0.42 deg radius.

MagnitudeConversion.comment: Magnitudes are already harmonised by Combine_Cats_select_Sapporro_v2.py (column Mw_typecons: Mv shifted by -0.1 onto the Md scale, Md = Mw within 0.005 for the 212 JMA-CMT pairs). 0.1 bins preserved.

McParameters.comment: fixed_mc is the completeness used for the ETAS fit and the mu / smoothed-seismicity fields (whole 0-75 km polygon; b vs cutoff flattens to within 0.05 above 3.0). The b map uses a cell-wise Mc: the lowest cutoff above which the local b stays flat over b_mc_plateau_bins successive 0.1 steps (tolerance max(b_mc_plateau_tol, 2.5 sigma_b)); cells with no plateau below b_mc_ceiling are undefined.

BValueParameters.comment: b neighbourhood radius scaled with the grid: 0.42 deg = 1.4 x cell size (0.7 deg at 0.5 deg cells). Fallback: 100 nearest within 2.5 deg, >= 30 events above the cell Mc.

ForwardPredictions.comment: Alarm template valid 2024-2030, fields from 2012-2023 (catalogue ends 2023-12-31), thresholds frozen from the 2012-2023 retrospective calibration; not updated with 2024+ data.
